content.title: Native cache invariant now covers actual finite admitted query sequences
content.text:

Numerical source callbacks preserve the auxiliary families independently of a future pattern. One fixed actual history supplies the main prefix Gamma. Singleton node preservation uses each true producer's actual admission. Singleton edge preservation reconstructs each actual child query, obtains its complete key, retains the SAME completed cell to the SAME reader, and applies the derived node invariant there. True Returned predicates supply operational cell evidence only. The checked body retains original child order, arity mismatch and sentinel branches. Optional and full NoNewMu are generalized to a genuine retained start. A terminal-step Returned lemma covers lookup/demand changes before non-yielding outcomes. The private one-query closure keeps ALL execute outcomes and EVERY bounded prefix; the public count induction derives its past Seeds internally.
